skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply accounting principles, characteristics of business operations, and accounting practices in insurance enterprises.
Understand and apply theories on financial reporting in life insurance companies.
Understand and apply theories on revenue and expense accounting in insurance enterprises.
Demonstrate the ability to work independently and in groups, research skills, logical and critical thinking, and presentation skills.
Understand and apply theories on short-term asset accounting in insurance enterprises.
Understand and apply theories on long-term asset accounting in insurance enterprises.
Understand and apply theories on capital accounting in insurance enterprises.
Understand and apply theories on revenue accounting in insurance enterprises.
Understand and apply theories on expense accounting in insurance enterprises.
Understand and apply theories on financial statement preparation in insurance enterprises.
